response.overview: The fourth video in Tom McComas' "I Love" series takes kids up close to the big machines they see every day, including bulldozers, big cranes, excavators, graders, steam tractors, trains, jets and more, showing how the machines work and the people who run them. Live-action footage is paired with humor and a spritely narration, made to entertain and teach young viewers at the same time.
response.title: I Love Big Machines
